description: I am detached from every outcome because what’s for me will always find its way 🥂 #detached #selfdiscovery #selflove
transcript: I am detached from every outcome because there has never been a person, place, or thing that hasn't been replaced with something greater. There has never been a moment of my life where there has been a stop sign or a roadblock that hasn't navigated me to a bigger, better, or more full life. I do not have to hold on to anything tightly. What's for me requires me to touch it lightly because when it's time for it to maneuver, it maneuvers and it maneuvers gently and places something greater in my hands.
